ezekiel.20.p1.b1.text: Have you come to inquire of Me? … I will not be consulted by you

ezekiel.20.p1.b2.text: Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.

ezekiel.20.p1.b3.text: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.

ezekiel.20.p1.b4.text: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us … Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness.

ezekiel.20.p1.b5.text: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.

ezekiel.20.p2.b1.text: Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

ezekiel.20.p2.b2.text: they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices

ezekiel.20.p2.b3.text: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?

ezekiel.20.p2.b4.text: Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone

ezekiel.20.p2.b5.text: I will rule over you. … I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

ezekiel.20.p3.b1.text: For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land.

ezekiel.20.p3.b2.text: There you will remember your ways and all the deeds with which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evils you have done.

ezekiel.20.p3.b3.text: I have dealt with you for the sake of My name and not according to your wicked ways and corrupt acts

ezekiel.20.p3.b4.text: I am about to ignite in you a fire, and it will devour all your trees, both green and dry.

ezekiel.20.p3.b5.text: Ah, Lord GOD, they are saying of me, ‘Is he not just telling parables?’
